about: Hand-maintained: examples/ folders (relative to examples/), or parts of them, that cannot run on the dind harness (test/harness). A row without "part" is a whole example whose <name>.tests.ps1 only validates it (Invoke-TfExample -ValidateOnly); a row with "part" names the block or argument its test removes or rewrites before applying the rest. ExampleCoverage (Invoke-Build) accepts a whole-example row instead of a runnable test; tools/deferred reads every row into reference/_gen/deferred.json (kind example). Remove a row in the change that makes that example (or part) run for real.

examples.reason: The harness daemons build with the docker driver on the overlay2 store and have no arm64 emulation, so the test builds linux/amd64 only. Multi-platform bake output is covered by TestAccBuildxP53_multiPlatform on cdnode.

Needs a self-signed TLS registry that already holds team/app:1.0; the harness tlsregistry is empty until TestAccRegistryImageDataInsecureSkipVerify seeds it over HTTPS, which covers insecure_skip_verify.
Needs real ghcr.io credentials; the test removes the provider block and asks Docker Hub for an anonymous pull token instead (as TestAccRegistryTokenEphemeral does).
Needs a BuildKit daemon reachable from the provider process over TCP with TLS; the harness has none (a docker-container builder's port is only published inside the dind manager).

Needs the live Docker Build Cloud service and Docker Hub credentials (TestAccBuildxBuilderCloud_live in acceptance.json, same reason); the harness has neither. The test removes both blocks and applies the rest.
The dind harness nodes run on a cgroup v2 hierarchy without io.weight, so runc fails to start a container with a block-IO weight; the test comments the argument out. Unit tests cover the update path.

Pushing one variant of a local multi-platform image needs the containerd image store and a registry the node and the provider reach under the same name; cdnode (containerd store) cannot reach the harness registry at 127.0.0.1:12380.
